lots.title: 25112 Library Services Engage, Design and Fit out Contract - Ely Library
lots.description: Single-supplier contract (not split into lots per §1.7.1) awarding engagement, design, and fit-out services for the redevelopment of Ely Library. The successful bidder engages with the Library team and stakeholders to understand needs and intended outcomes, creates final design options covering furniture, waypoints and signage, and then delivers the fit-out and furniture supply. Estimated total value £150,000 ex VAT / £180,000 inc VAT over an initial 6-month term (from 7 July 2026) with potential 6-month extension, followed by a 12-month defects period. Detailed technical requirements are carried in Appendix 4 Specification (external to this ITT). Contract reference DN797266. Commissioned on behalf of Cambridgeshire County Council Library services (33 locations across Cambridgeshire excluding Peterborough).
requirements: Engage with the Library team and other stakeholders to understand needs and intended outcomes of the Ely Library redevelopment (§1.4.1).
Create final design options and approaches covering furniture, waypoints and signage (§1.4.2).
Deliver the final design, including fit-out and furniture supply, following design sign-off (§1.4.1, Appendix 3 §3.3.1).
Comply with detailed requirements defined in Appendix 4 Specification and associated appendices (§1.4.3) — external document, not inlined in this ITT.
Anticipated contract commencement 7 July 2026; initial term 6 months with potential 6-month extension (§1.5.1, §1.5.2).
Maintain a 12-month defects period in addition to the contract term, commencing at final handover and sign-off (§1.5.3).
Hold tender open for acceptance by the Authority for 180 days from the submission closing date (§2.8.1).
Submit tenders via ProContract only, by the deadline of 12:00 noon on 22 May 2026; no embedded files (§2.10).
Tender and all accompanying documents must be in English (§2.10 item 3).
Bidders must not include assumptions, qualifications, exclusions, or clarifications within the tender submission; raise such matters during the clarification period (§2.11 Important Note).
No personal information permitted in responses; AI/ML tool use must be clearly identified (§2.10).
Consortia and subcontracting arrangements must be identified, including share of contract to be subcontracted and proposed subcontractors (§4.4.1).
Successful bidder must register on Match My Project (MMP) portal as a minimum social value requirement (§3.4).
Successful bidder must sign the Authority's Climate Charter (§4.3.1).
Successful bidder must register on Find a Tender service / Central Digital Platform and supply the Unique Identifier prior to contract signing (§5.5 — as of 1 April 2026).
Public Liability insurance with limit of indemnity of not less than £5,000,000 per claim or series of claims (§4.5.1(a)).
Employer's Liability insurance with limit of indemnity of not less than £5,000,000 per claim or series of claims (§4.5.1(b)).
Professional Indemnity insurance with limit of indemnity of not less than £2,000,000 per claim and in aggregate per insurance period (§4.5.1(c)).
Product Liability insurance with limit of indemnity of not less than £1,000,000 per claim or series of claims (§4.5.1(d)).
Conditional or variant tenders will not be accepted (§2.9).
Bidders must not alter unit of measure or quantity on the Pricing Schedule (Appendix 3a) where stated (Appendix 3 §3.8).
Exit plan to be worked up with the Authority as detailed in Appendix 4 Specification (§4.2.2).
Complete Conditions of Participation Questionnaire (CPQ) including all mandatory pass/fail questions before progressing to Award evaluation (§3.2, Appendix One).

evaluation_criteria.summary: Most Advantageous Tender (MAT) methodology with relative weighting of Price 50% and Quality 50%; Below Threshold Open Procedure under Section 85 of the Procurement Act 2023. Total Questionnaire weight 100%.

Each question scored on an even-only 0/2/4/6/8/10 scale: 0 very weak/no answer, 2 poor, 4 satisfactory, 6 good, 8 very good, 10 exceptional. Moderated score / 10 × question weighting gives question contribution.
